text: Eight boxes A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are placed one above another in a stack but not in the same order as given. More than six boxes are placed above box F. Box B is placed three boxes below box G. Four boxes are placed between box F and box H. Box C is placed immediately below box B. Three boxes are placed between box E and box H. Box D is placed above box G. Which of the following boxes is placed just below box G?
explanation: From the top the order is D, G, H, A, B, C, E, F. The box just below G is H.
